tabs.tab_title: Are the courses available online or only in Colombo?
tabs.tab_content: All DMIT courses are fully available online — you can learn from anywhere in Sri Lanka or abroad. We also offer in-person sessions at our Colombo 03 campus for students who prefer a classroom environment.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need any prior experience to enroll?
tabs.tab_content: Most courses are designed for complete beginners. We also offer intermediate and advanced tracks. Each course page clearly states the level required, so there’s always a path for every learner.

tabs.tab_title: Are DMIT certificates recognised by employers?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. DMIT certificates are widely recognised across Sri Lanka and are verifiable digitally. We are also an authorised Google and Meta training partner, so qualifying courses come with internationally recognised credentials.
Absolutely. We offer flexible instalment plans on all courses. Contact our admissions team and we’ll set up a payment schedule that works for your budget.

tabs.tab_title: Is BrightMind suitable for working professionals?
tabs.tab_content: Our courses are self-paced with lifetime access, so you can learn at your own schedule. Most students complete courses while working full-time, typically dedicating 5–8 hours per week.
